compiled.title: adr003

match.why: We will stop using default exports except when absolutely necessary (such as React.lazy modules).
They break re-exports due to name conflicts, forcing the developer to manually name each.
This is often hidden by Babel's module interop ... break re-exports due to name conflicts.
